fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on the safety and sinking of Dade County’s new 27-story courthouse building; calls for a Miami harbor patrol to address theft, dumping of oily bilge, and harbor incidents; criticism of apartment owners’ “on application” rates and tourist gouging; notes on Biscayne Boulevard hazards; police court items including bootlegging bond forfeiture versus sentencing; complaints about poor streetcar transportation; and sports coverage promoting a potential Jack Dempsey fight in Miami and related arena fundraising.
